title: Comments state machine and display logic
description: Separates backend shapes from display decisions
body: Comments as this app reads them: the shapes the backend stores, and the pure decisions about how a list of them is shown. The types mirror `src-tauri/src/design_comments.rs` and are restated rather than imported. Everything else here is a function of a comment and nothing else, so the ordering and the wording can be tested without a backend.
